name: Distillate Capital Partners LLC
summary: Distillate Capital Partners LLC appears in Part 12 of The Buildout. Part 12: The Model Is Not the Price. Argued in Part 12 (The filing sets the price).

parts.headline: The Model Is Not the Price

mentions.excerpt: Distillate Capital Partners LLC, on July 15, counted roughly $180 billion committed by the hyperscalers and Nvidia to the two labs, about $1.1 trillion of compute pledged back, and $53 billion of first-quarter hyperscaler net income, 34% of the total, booked as non-cash marks on those stakes.
